subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: Should the WhatsApp plugin change its default linked-device identity and require affected existing sessions to re-pair, or preserve the current identity behind a compatibility path?
rationale: The reliable fix appears to change pairing-time identity, so maintainers must choose the upgrade behavior and operator recovery experience before implementation.

options.title: Desktop default plus guided re-pair
options.body: Adopt the supported Desktop identity and add health/Doctor detection with an explicit QR re-pair recovery flow for affected existing sessions.

options.title: Compatibility transition
options.body: Introduce a bounded transition that preserves existing pairings temporarily while new links use the corrected identity, with a documented removal plan.

options.title: Advanced identity setting
options.body: Expose an operator-selected browser identity, increasing configuration and support burden while leaving an unsafe default choice possible.

recommendation.title: Desktop default plus guided re-pair
recommendation.body: Adopt the supported Desktop identity and add health/Doctor detection with an explicit QR re-pair recovery flow for affected existing sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is prior ownership of WhatsApp group-inbound recovery on the same session path.
